Based on the results of the previous steps, I will label this issue as a new feature since it is requesting a change in behavior for CSV exports to neutralize text starting with special characters. The file that would primarily be affected by this change is `src/util/money.ts`, as it involves CSV exports. Here is the comment I will post:


```json
  "issue": "issue-4331",
```

input.title: Neutralise text values starting with special characters in CSV exports
input.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Modify the CSV export functionality to neutralise text values that start with '=', '+', '-', or '@' by prefixing them with a single quote or other neutralising character, preventing them from being treated as formulas in applications like Excel or Google Sheets. This will ensure descriptions like `=HYPERLINK(...)` are treated as plain text rather than as executable formulas.
